selectedFunctions.label: Treehouse Deposit ERC20 into tETH
warnings: Treehouse tETH Ethereum only. Inputs/outputs are integer raw token/share units, not fiat or interchangeable ETH equivalents. Router deposit amount uses the selected ERC20 decimals; depositETH uses msg.value wei.

Router constructor binds WETH 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2, stETH 0xae7ab96520DE3A18E5e111B5EaAb095312D7fE84, wstETH 0x7f39C581F595B53c5cb19bD0b3f8dA6c935E2Ca0 and official vault. Only vault-allowable assets work; non-underlying conversion explicitly supports WETH/stETH into wstETH. Not an arbitrary-token zap.

Actual tETH ERC4626 asset is the internal accounting unit (IAU), not WETH/wstETH/ETH. TAsset _deposit/_withdraw requires caller to be an authorized IAU minter. Do not call token ERC4626 deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem as a generic ordinary-user vault; use admitted router/redemption entrypoints.

Router pulls ERC20 from msg.sender after approval to router and mints tETH to msg.sender. Deposit cap and pause checks can revert; router has no minShares or deadline parameter and conversion/rounding can change.

Redemption redeem(uint96) escrows raw tETH shares, not ETH or wstETH assets, and requires tETH approval to Redemption V3. minRedeemInUnderlying is measured in underlying accounting units. No instant payout: finalizeRedeem(index) is a separate transaction after configured waitingPeriod (docs describe approximately seven days).

finalizeRedeem claims only msg.sender indexed request, checks blacklist and maturity, and pays vault underlying wstETH via the allowlisted RedemptionController. Fees and the minimum-of-initiation/finalization exchange-rate haircut reduce output. Vault liquidity, controller authorization and pauses can block claims. Indexes move on deletion; re-read pending requests rather than reusing stale indexes.

redeemWithNft ALWAYS surrenders the caller owned/approved NFT to nftTreasury, even above minimum size. Only exemptionGate accepted collections qualify; disabled gate, zero-worth redemption or unaccepted collection reverts. This is a paid ticket path, not a free whitelist bypass; it does not bypass blacklist/maturity checks.

Catalog provenance is document/explorer source evidence only, not fresh RPC bytecode/storage/configuration or successful execution evidence. Pauses, roles, allowances, caps, liquidity and independent execution controls remain authoritative; principal can be lost.
